title: Functions
overview: A focused revision guide to functions.

sections.title: Functions
bullets: Domain = valid inputs, range = resulting outputs — state both when asked to "describe" a function.
Composite function fg(x) means "do g first, then f" — work inside-out.
Inverse f⁻¹(x): swap x and y, rearrange. Only exists properly if f is one-to-one over the given domain — you may need to restrict the domain first.
Graph transformations: f(x)+a shifts up, f(x+a) shifts left, af(x) stretches vertically, f(ax) squashes horizontally.

examTips: When a domain is restricted before asking for an inverse, give the range of f as the domain of f⁻¹ — a commonly lost mark.
